sources.title: toandev/Gemma4-12B-Uncensored · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Gemma4-12B-Uncensored Gemma4-12B-Uncensored is a research-oriented derivative of google/gemma-4-12B-it, prepared for experiments on refusal behavior, over-refusal, and multimodal instruction-following robustness. The checkpoint is released as a clean full-weight BF16 Gemma 4 unified model.
